failed_request_ratio: sum( rate( gateway_failed_requests_total{ job="gateway" }[10s] ) ) / clamp_min( sum( rate( gateway_http_requests_total{ job="gateway" }[10s] ) ), 1e-9 )
faf_by_key: ( sum by (key) ( increase( gateway_backend_calls_total{ job="gateway", key=~"/api/backend/(1|2|3|4|5|6)" }[10s] ) ) / sum by (key) ( increase( gateway_logical_refreshes_total{ job="gateway", key=~"/api/backend/(1|2|3|4|5|6)" }[10s] ) ) ) and on (key) ( sum by (key) ( increase( gateway_logical_refreshes_total{ job="gateway", key=~"/api/backend/(1|2|3|4|5|6)" }[10s] ) ) > 0 )
average_request_duration: sum( rate( gateway_request_duration_seconds_sum{ job="gateway" }[10s] ) ) / clamp_min( sum( rate( gateway_request_duration_seconds_count{ job="gateway" }[10s] ) ), 1e-9 )
average_backend_duration: sum( rate( gateway_backend_duration_seconds_sum{ job="gateway" }[10s] ) ) / clamp_min( sum( rate( gateway_backend_duration_seconds_count{ job="gateway" }[10s] ) ), 1e-9 )
failure_amplification_factor: sum( increase( backend_requests_total{ job="backend" }[242s] ) ) / clamp_min( sum( increase( gateway_http_requests_total{ job="gateway" }[242s] ) ), 1 )
cache_hit_ratio_total: ( sum( rate( gateway_l1_hits_total{ job="gateway" }[10s] ) ) + sum( rate( gateway_l2_hits_total{ job="gateway" }[10s] ) ) ) / clamp_min( sum( rate( gateway_http_requests_total{ job="gateway" }[10s] ) ), 1e-9 )
cache_hit_ratio_l1: sum( rate( gateway_l1_hits_total{ job="gateway" }[10s] ) ) / clamp_min( sum( rate( gateway_http_requests_total{ job="gateway" }[10s] ) ), 1e-9 )
cache_hit_ratio_l2: sum( rate( gateway_l2_hits_total{ job="gateway" }[10s] ) ) / clamp_min( sum( rate( gateway_http_requests_total{ job="gateway" }[10s] ) ), 1e-9 )
request_duration_p95: histogram_quantile( 0.95, sum by (le) ( rate( gateway_request_duration_seconds_bucket{ job="gateway" }[10s] ) ) )
request_duration_p99: histogram_quantile( 0.99, sum by (le) ( rate( gateway_request_duration_seconds_bucket{ job="gateway" }[10s] ) ) )
